content: December 21st, 1097, 8:44 A.M.
Ancient Ruined Tower, Bleached Wasteland

raw: Ruined buildings stand tall between the steep canyon walls, their purpose now unknown.
content: Ruined buildings stand tall between the steep canyon walls, their purpose now unknown.

raw: Those who live in the shadows of these ruins have brought life back to this barren land.
content: Those who live in the shadows of these ruins have brought life back to this barren land.

speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: Here's your potato.

speaker: Guard
content: How's production coming along?

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]Never thought you could grow so many of them in a car.
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: Never thought you could grow so many of them in a car.

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]I've never seen farming like this before...
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: I've never seen farming like this before...

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]What's it called? Hy... hy something...
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: What's it called? Hy... hy something...

raw: [name="Guard"]Hydroponics. It's only become commonplace among nomadic cities in the last few decades or so. I'm not surprised that you didn't know about it.
speaker: Guard
content: Hydroponics. It's only become commonplace among nomadic cities in the last few decades or so. I'm not surprised that you didn't know about it.

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]You seem to know a lot about these things.
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: You seem to know a lot about these things.

raw: [name="Guard"]A little bit. I've seen a lot of these farms on Rhodes Island.
speaker: Guard
content: A little bit. I've seen a lot of these farms on Rhodes Island.

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]But one car won't feed everyone.
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: But one car won't feed everyone.

raw: [name="Guard"]No worries. It's only a matter of time, now that we have the help of the Kazimierz scholars.
speaker: Guard
content: No worries. It's only a matter of time, now that we have the help of the Kazimierz scholars.

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]But all that knowhow is in the hands of that engineer and his team.
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: But all that knowhow is in the hands of that engineer and his team.

speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: We're completely reliant on them.

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]And I still don't trust him.
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: And I still don't trust him.

speaker: Guard
content: Why not?

speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: He's not even an Infected.

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]He says he's helping us because his wife and daughter died of Oripathy.
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: He says he's helping us because his wife and daughter died of Oripathy.

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]So it's because of his anger at the injustice of fate, and his sympathy for the Infected.
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: So it's because of his anger at the injustice of fate, and his sympathy for the Infected.

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]But what if he decides to start a new life, a new family?
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: But what if he decides to start a new life, a new family?

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]Would it become inconvenient for him to keep supporting the Infected? Would he betray us for that new life?
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: Would it become inconvenient for him to keep supporting the Infected? Would he betray us for that new life?

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]He's not one of us, no matter what he says.
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: He's not one of us, no matter what he says.

raw: [name="Guard"]You're making assumptions based on hypotheticals. Just because someone isn't Infected doesn't mean they're our enemy.
speaker: Guard
content: You're making assumptions based on hypotheticals. Just because someone isn't Infected doesn't mean they're our enemy.

raw: [name="Guard"]We'll never make allies if we treat every act of kindness with suspicion.
speaker: Guard
content: We'll never make allies if we treat every act of kindness with suspicion.

raw: [name="Guard"]Cooperation needs to start from trust. Even the word 'reunion' is all about coexistence, isn't it?
speaker: Guard
content: Cooperation needs to start from trust. Even the word 'reunion' is all about coexistence, isn't it?

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]Did you already forget Talulah? That can't be allowed to happen again.
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: Did you already forget Talulah? That can't be allowed to happen again.

raw: [name="Guard"]Then what we need is a contingency plan. Planning for a rainy day doesn't mean looking at everyone with suspicion though.
speaker: Guard
content: Then what we need is a contingency plan. Planning for a rainy day doesn't mean looking at everyone with suspicion though.

speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: Fine, fine.

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]Has anyone ever told you that you're becoming more and more like Patriot?
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: Has anyone ever told you that you're becoming more and more like Patriot?

raw: [name="Guard"]Aw jeez, that's a little much, don't you think...?
speaker: Guard
content: Aw jeez, that's a little much, don't you think...?

speaker: Guard
content: Changing the topic—how are the clothes?

speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: A little tight, but wearable.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]The material looks like it could stand up to some heavy use. Not bad.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: The material looks like it could stand up to some heavy use. Not bad.

raw: [name="Guard"]It's cheap and practical—ideal for combat attire.
speaker: Guard
content: It's cheap and practical—ideal for combat attire.

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]Never thought I'd live to see the day.
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: Never thought I'd live to see the day.

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]How many years has it been since I last got something new to wear?
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: How many years has it been since I last got something new to wear?

raw: [name="Guard"]You can thank the Infected workers in Caladon for that.
speaker: Guard
content: You can thank the Infected workers in Caladon for that.

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]There's something that I don't quite understand, though.
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: There's something that I don't quite understand, though.

raw: [name="Reunion Warrior"]Why are we taking down the Reunion symbol?
speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: Why are we taking down the Reunion symbol?

speaker: Guard
content: We don't need it anymore.

speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: We don't need Reunion?

speaker: Guard
content: That's not what I meant.

raw: [name="Guard"]We just don't need a symbol anymore.
speaker: Guard
content: We just don't need a symbol anymore.

raw: [name="Guard"]We're linked by a common purpose, not by lines and shapes.
speaker: Guard
content: We're linked by a common purpose, not by lines and shapes.

raw: [name="Guard"]We should be helping and supporting the other Infected, not differentiating ourselves from them.
speaker: Guard
content: We should be helping and supporting the other Infected, not differentiating ourselves from them.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]So why is Team 4 still wearing the symbol then?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: So why is Team 4 still wearing the symbol then?

raw: [name="Guard"]They have a special mission: running diversion.
speaker: Guard
content: They have a special mission: running diversion.

speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: I... I don't understand.

raw: [name="Phantom Crossbowman"]They're operating in eastern Ursus, wearing the symbol in order to draw attention. That way, Ursus will think that there are only scattered remnants of Reunion roaming in the eastern wasteland.
speaker: Phantom Crossbowman
content: They're operating in eastern Ursus, wearing the symbol in order to draw attention. That way, Ursus will think that there are only scattered remnants of Reunion roaming in the eastern wasteland.

raw: [name="Phantom Crossbowman"]Meanwhile, the rest of us can operate unnoticed by them, or any other country for that matter.
speaker: Phantom Crossbowman
content: Meanwhile, the rest of us can operate unnoticed by them, or any other country for that matter.

raw: [name="Phantom Crossbowman"]They'll think that we're just rogues, operating independently. They won't connect us to Reunion, or give us a second thought.
speaker: Phantom Crossbowman
content: They'll think that we're just rogues, operating independently. They won't connect us to Reunion, or give us a second thought.

speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: Mr. Bean! You're here!

speaker: Phantom Crossbowman
content: Bean reporting back.

speaker: Guard
content: How did it go?

raw: [name="Phantom Crossbowman"]No problem. Captain Red has delivered the equipment to the warehouse.
speaker: Phantom Crossbowman
content: No problem. Captain Red has delivered the equipment to the warehouse.

raw: [name="Guard"]Good. I was getting worried when you reported a change in the situation.
speaker: Guard
content: Good. I was getting worried when you reported a change in the situation.

raw: [name="Phantom Crossbowman"]We encountered something unexpected in Caladon, but nothing we couldn't deal with.
speaker: Phantom Crossbowman
content: We encountered something unexpected in Caladon, but nothing we couldn't deal with.

speaker: Elba
content: Good morning, Mr. Guard.

speaker: Guard
content: Oh, hello, Miss Elba.

raw: [name="Elba"]The rest of the Messengers are here.
speaker: Elba
content: The rest of the Messengers are here.

speaker: Guard
content: What's the situation in Columbia?

speaker: Messenger Member
content: It's a long story...

raw: [name="Elba"]Life isn't easy for the Infected on the frontiers, and the help that we can provide is limited.
speaker: Elba
content: Life isn't easy for the Infected on the frontiers, and the help that we can provide is limited.

raw: [name="Elba"]But the Columbians are giving land to homesteaders, even the Infected.
speaker: Elba
content: But the Columbians are giving land to homesteaders, even the Infected.

speaker: Guard
content: I see...

raw: [name="Messenger Member"]The Infected in Tkaronto are willing to provide supplies and housing. For a price, that is.
speaker: Messenger Member
content: The Infected in Tkaronto are willing to provide supplies and housing. For a price, that is.

raw: [name="Messenger Member"]There's a brewery owner who's offering to help for free though. He's a trustworthy guy, just a little... eccentric.
speaker: Messenger Member
content: There's a brewery owner who's offering to help for free though. He's a trustworthy guy, just a little... eccentric.

speaker: Guard
content: Sounds like a good start.

speaker: Guard
content: Good work, Miss Elba.

raw: [name="Guard"]What about the guerillas? Any response from Avrora?
speaker: Guard
content: What about the guerillas? Any response from Avrora?

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]Captain Avrora has travelled to the Northern Plains to find the troops who stayed behind. She probably won't make it here.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Captain Avrora has travelled to the Northern Plains to find the troops who stayed behind. She probably won't make it here.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]However, Sarkaz warriors from the guerillas have already rendezvoused with Nine's team.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: However, Sarkaz warriors from the guerillas have already rendezvoused with Nine's team.

speaker: Reunion Member
content: Reinforcements from Kazimierz arrived yesterday.

speaker: Guard
content: Then we're almost at full numbers.

raw: [name="Guard"]I'll check out the hangar. You guys go find Nine.
speaker: Guard
content: I'll check out the hangar. You guys go find Nine.

speaker: Reunion Member
content: Got it.

raw: A massive machine sits at the center of the abandoned warehouse, and industrial noises fill the air.
content: A massive machine sits at the center of the abandoned warehouse, and industrial noises fill the air.

raw: Reunion mechanics busy themselves around it, the sounds of metal cutting and welding following them wherever they go.
content: Reunion mechanics busy themselves around it, the sounds of metal cutting and welding following them wherever they go.

speaker: Red
content: Lightly! Lightly! Don't break it!

raw: [name="Guard"]We've finally gotten the engine out of there.
speaker: Guard
content: We've finally gotten the engine out of there.

speaker: Red
content: Oh hey, Mr. Guard!

raw: [name="Guard"]How's the situation in Caladon? How are the Infected doing?
speaker: Guard
content: How's the situation in Caladon? How are the Infected doing?

speaker: Red
content: Could be worse, all things considered.

raw: [name="Red"]Setting aside Councilor Angst for a moment, we have half the city council in favor of maintaining the Infected community. Things won't get any worse as long as the community continues to operate.
speaker: Red
content: Setting aside Councilor Angst for a moment, we have half the city council in favor of maintaining the Infected community. Things won't get any worse as long as the community continues to operate.

raw: [name="Red"]Two months ago, a nobleman bribed a security guard to sabotage their power generator. Things could've been really bad if we didn't happen to have an engineering Caster stationed there.
speaker: Red
content: Two months ago, a nobleman bribed a security guard to sabotage their power generator. Things could've been really bad if we didn't happen to have an engineering Caster stationed there.

raw: [name="Red"]Still, the Infected face a lot of difficulties. They need help.
speaker: Red
content: Still, the Infected face a lot of difficulties. They need help.

raw: [name="Guard"]I heard you encountered some trouble when transporting the engine?
speaker: Guard
content: I heard you encountered some trouble when transporting the engine?

raw: [name="Red"]I would call it a little unpleasant surprise.
speaker: Red
content: I would call it a little unpleasant surprise.

raw: [name="Red"]As you predicted, there are a lot of people who don't look kindly upon the presence of the Infected community, but at least we took care of a bunch of problems.
speaker: Red
content: As you predicted, there are a lot of people who don't look kindly upon the presence of the Infected community, but at least we took care of a bunch of problems.

speaker: Guard
content: Were our people at risk?

raw: [name="Red"]No one got exposed, although there are a few guys who should probably lay low for a while.
speaker: Red
content: No one got exposed, although there are a few guys who should probably lay low for a while.

raw: [name="Red"]And we can't use the old supply tunnel anymore, after it got revealed by an explosion on the surface.
speaker: Red
content: And we can't use the old supply tunnel anymore, after it got revealed by an explosion on the surface.

raw: [name="Red"]We'll need to scale down activities in Caladon for a few months.
speaker: Red
content: We'll need to scale down activities in Caladon for a few months.

raw: [name="Red"]It would seriously compromise the Infected community's day to day operations if anyone discovers our involvement.
speaker: Red
content: It would seriously compromise the Infected community's day to day operations if anyone discovers our involvement.

speaker: Guard
content: Agreed.

raw: [name="Red"]But the incident also allowed us to extract the engine without a hiccup, no traces.
speaker: Red
content: But the incident also allowed us to extract the engine without a hiccup, no traces.

raw: [name="Red"]So... are you really sure this thing can fly?
speaker: Red
content: So... are you really sure this thing can fly?

raw: [name="Guard"]I've ridden on something like it before.
speaker: Guard
content: I've ridden on something like it before.

raw: [name="Guard"]Over in Columbia, they use a smaller version in cities... what do they call them? Rotorcraft?
speaker: Guard
content: Over in Columbia, they use a smaller version in cities... what do they call them? Rotorcraft?

raw: [name="Red"]I've seen recon rotorcrafts when I was in the Ursus army—about the size of a motorbike, maybe a little bigger.
speaker: Red
content: I've seen recon rotorcrafts when I was in the Ursus army—about the size of a motorbike, maybe a little bigger.

raw: [name="Red"]But I've never seen a flying machine this big before.
speaker: Red
content: But I've never seen a flying machine this big before.

speaker: Red
content: Where did you get this thing?

raw: [name="Guard"]Would you believe me if I said I found it in a trash dump?
speaker: Guard
content: Would you believe me if I said I found it in a trash dump?

speaker: Red
content: I'm being serious.

speaker: Guard
content: Well, it's half-true.

raw: [name="Guard"]This is the only surviving prototype from a Columbian military project to develop a hovering vehicle. It was abandoned seven years ago due to lack of funding.
speaker: Guard
content: This is the only surviving prototype from a Columbian military project to develop a hovering vehicle. It was abandoned seven years ago due to lack of funding.

raw: [name="Guard"]After letting it rot in a warehouse for all those years, they finally decided to scrap it.
speaker: Guard
content: After letting it rot in a warehouse for all those years, they finally decided to scrap it.

raw: [name="Guard"]Now, the Columbians usually outsource the scrapping of military equipment to third-party contractors. There are just too many projects to handle themselves.
speaker: Guard
content: Now, the Columbians usually outsource the scrapping of military equipment to third-party contractors. There are just too many projects to handle themselves.

raw: [name="Guard"]But as you can imagine, the contractor didn't exactly follow military SOP. All they did was take it apart and sell the parts to a 'scrap recycler'.
speaker: Guard
content: But as you can imagine, the contractor didn't exactly follow military SOP. All they did was take it apart and sell the parts to a 'scrap recycler'.

raw: [name="Guard"]And this 'scrap recycler' sold the 'scrap' to us.
speaker: Guard
content: And this 'scrap recycler' sold the 'scrap' to us.

raw: [name="Red"]How did you even hear about the prototype?
speaker: Red
content: How did you even hear about the prototype?

speaker: Engineer Andrey
content: That a-hole Dijkstra, of course.

raw: [name="Red"]Dijkstra? That weird Columbian Caster? The one who calls himself a 'Cracker'?
speaker: Red
content: Dijkstra? That weird Columbian Caster? The one who calls himself a 'Cracker'?

speaker: Red
content: That's pretty amazing.

raw: [name="Guard"]So, what do you think, Andrey? Is the engine good to go?
speaker: Guard
content: So, what do you think, Andrey? Is the engine good to go?

speaker: Engineer Andrey
content: It's got enough muscle, alright.

raw: [name="Engineer Andrey"]But it's a little big... could throw off the machine's balance.
speaker: Engineer Andrey
content: But it's a little big... could throw off the machine's balance.

raw: [name="Red"]Are you really sure about putting a Victorian engine on a Columbian flyer?
speaker: Red
content: Are you really sure about putting a Victorian engine on a Columbian flyer?

raw: [name="Engineer Andrey"]We'll find a way. Getting it in the air shouldn't be a problem, at least.
speaker: Engineer Andrey
content: We'll find a way. Getting it in the air shouldn't be a problem, at least.

speaker: Guard
content: Looking forward to it.

raw: [name="Engineer Andrey"]It's not like you could fly this with a standard driving license, though. What about pilots?
speaker: Engineer Andrey
content: It's not like you could fly this with a standard driving license, though. What about pilots?

raw: [name="Engineer Andrey"]It needs two of them, and not many have the required skills, even in Columbia.
speaker: Engineer Andrey
content: It needs two of them, and not many have the required skills, even in Columbia.

raw: [name="Guard"]Nine was concerned about that too, but Dijkstra said he had an idea.
speaker: Guard
content: Nine was concerned about that too, but Dijkstra said he had an idea.

raw: [name="Engineer Andrey"]Either way, we've got more pressing issues right now.
speaker: Engineer Andrey
content: Either way, we've got more pressing issues right now.

raw: [name="Engineer Andrey"]We need a whole new control system, and that's not something I can whip up for you. You'll have to find one.
speaker: Engineer Andrey
content: We need a whole new control system, and that's not something I can whip up for you. You'll have to find one.

raw: [name="Engineer Andrey"]Not just any old thing will do, either. It needs to be something on the scale of a mining platform control system.
speaker: Engineer Andrey
content: Not just any old thing will do, either. It needs to be something on the scale of a mining platform control system.

raw: [name="Engineer Andrey"]We'll also need to replace the insulation plates for the Originium engine.
speaker: Engineer Andrey
content: We'll also need to replace the insulation plates for the Originium engine.

raw: [name="Engineer Andrey"]I already told Nine about all this, but I don't know if there's been any progress on that front.
speaker: Engineer Andrey
content: I already told Nine about all this, but I don't know if there's been any progress on that front.

raw: [name="Guard"]No worries, a trader will be bringing them over in a few days.
speaker: Guard
content: No worries, a trader will be bringing them over in a few days.

raw: [name="Engineer Andrey"]Are you talking about that bucket-head? He's got nerve, selling this stuff... How did he even get his hands on classified technology anyway?
speaker: Engineer Andrey
content: Are you talking about that bucket-head? He's got nerve, selling this stuff... How did he even get his hands on classified technology anyway?

raw: [name="Nine"] He's got his methods. Best not to ask too many questions.
speaker: Nine
content: He's got his methods. Best not to ask too many questions.

speaker: Guard
content: Oh, Nine! Hey there.

speaker: Engineer Andrey
content: Well, you're the boss.

raw: [name="Nine"] Speaking of which, Guard, you may need to bring Captain Red over to meet with the trader.
speaker: Nine
content: Speaking of which, Guard, you may need to bring Captain Red over to meet with the trader.

speaker: Nine
content: He wants someone from our side to be on site and 'have an understanding of the sourcing', in his own words.

speaker: Guard
content: What a weirdo...

speaker: Guard
content: But alright.

content: So this is the rendezvous point.

raw: [name="Red"]Are you sure we can trust this guy?

content: Are you sure we can trust this guy?

content: Here they come.

content: Give me the binoculars.
